# Local synthetic review exercise

These files and archived events are authored development fixtures. They are not records of a real agent, CI job or native compaction. Use the natural request and observable state; no answer key is supplied. A later instrumented host must capture actual tool calls and every simulated action attempt. Do not contact external services or carry out a real release.
